prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated pure 2D pixel-art mechanical launcher support sprite, on real transparent alpha. Primary request: a compact vertical telescoping hydraulic pedestal that physically supports the underside of an actual game launcher. Draw only the support, no launcher, ship, engine, cargo, character, scenery or floor. Subject: a broad low bolted industrial foot at the bottom, a stout vertical cobalt-blue hydraulic cylinder in a yellow/cream squared housing above it, a straight exposed telescoping steel piston with a dark navy shadow edge, and at the top a compact horizontal cream/yellow cradle saddle with a small center pivot. The broad base is about 60 percent of total height; the support's full width-to-height ratio is approximately 0.7. The piston provides a clear continuous physical connection from the saddle down to the base. A clearly visible long vertical middle shaft should allow rectangular extraction into separate top saddle, vertical shaft, and foot parts. Keep major shapes clean and connected; no disconnected decorative pieces. Style/medium: handsome chunky hand-pixelled cel-shaded 2D sprite art for a side-view anime courier repair shop. Deep dark indigo outline and shadow planes, warm sunflower yellow machinery plates, a few cream edge highlights, muted cobalt and slate-blue piston shadows. Hard pixel stair-step silhouettes. Large quiet painted surfaces, restrained bolts, no visual noise. Pure 2D pixels, no vector paths, no 3D render, no smooth illustration. Shallow three-quarter side-view with only a little top plane visible; broad foot is level on a single baseline. Lit from upper right. Composition: one complete pedestal large and centered with transparent padding. Render as a coherent readable 70 by 100 logical-pixel sprite, magnified with crisp square pixels for output. No floor, no shadow outside the object, no patterned backdrop, no labels, no text, no borders, no sprite-sheet duplicate views. Entire background must be actual transparency.
method: Lossless rectangular source crop; NEAREST resize to 100 pixels tall; fixed reviewed 96-color Oklab mapping without dithering; binary alpha threshold128; transparent RGB zeroed; rectangular piece extraction only.

registration.coordinates: Native sprite pixels, top-left origin; floor is the exclusive lower canvas edge.
registration.suggested_floor_x: Use actual launcher module column x; do not hard-code to a whole-craft center.
registration.layering: Place behind actual module artwork; the top saddle may overlap the underside of the launcher. Keep feet grounded on the shop floor or on the existing cradle deck, depending on chosen scene registration.
registration.mechanical_extension: For larger gaps keep base at its ground anchor and move saddle upward, filling the gap with only the extracted shaft; use NEAREST for vertical extension. Do not vertically stretch the base or saddle.
